subject: lazy pig (local-wilding mascot, grounded poses)
notes: typed construction spec for render_audit --spec, grounded sibling of canon/pig.json. Regions are fractions of the SUBJECT bbox [y0,x0,y1,x1]. Identity claims: FAT (subject_aspect_min - a lazy pig is wide not tall), belly mass solid in the bottom band, snout midtone ring survives, ears at the head end, tail at the rear. _l/_r region pairs share a named_failure and OR together so mirrored poses (flee faces left) check the correct end. exclude_near_dom_dist=2 lets the DPINK snout ring count as its own midtone (dist 3 from body PINK; nostril dots still dark-excluded).
